_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); home-improvement retail signals

pit_profile.why: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 2,129 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 213 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not

theme_watch.reason: Live: Lowe's own FY2016 10-K says 'We face growing competition from online and multi-channel retailers who have a similar product or service offering. Customers are increasingly able to quickly comparison shop and determine real-time product availability and price using digital tools.' At the same time it sells online itself: 'In 2016, sales through our online selling channels accounted for approximately 3.5% of our total sales.'. The stock trades at 18.7x FY17E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing online substitution of Lowe's store sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: Lowe's: the world's second largest home improvement retailer, 2,129 home improvement and hardware stores in the U.S., Canada and Mexico with approximately 213 million square feet, serving do-it-yourself, do-it-for-me and professional customers; its sales follow housing turnover and the activity level of home improvement projects (its own 10-K), the franchise does not. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B 0.84x; +33% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.04; conservative 2yr +37%.

summary: LOW (retrospective, 2017-06-02) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.84x (50.1% downside to Bear $40 / +59.6% upside to Bull $128) | Adj composite 2.05 vs market 2.01: gap +0.04 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +33% above the EPP floor $60 (14x FY17E $4.30) | Conservative 2-yr case: +36.8% total (+18.4%/yr) | At 18.7x FY17E the 15% hurdle price $106 sits at or below the BASE case; comps +1.9% in Q1 FY17, forward sales +5% (FY17 sales guide); e-commerce competition is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
